# ClassDojo Classroom MCP

Canonical repository: https://github.com/Eason0in/classdojo-mcp
Package name: classdojo-mcp
MCP Registry name: io.github.Eason0in/classdojo-mcp
Transport: stdio
License: MIT
Status: unofficial and experimental

ClassDojo Classroom MCP is a local-first Model Context Protocol server for reviewable roster imports and exact classroom-skill synchronization with explicit confirmation and read-back verification.

Important facts:

- It is not affiliated with or endorsed by ClassDojo.
- ClassDojo has not yet released its explored public API/MCP; this version is a local teacher-web UI adapter.
- Users authenticate themselves in a dedicated local Chromium profile. The server does not request passwords, cookies, or API tokens.
- Workbook parsing and browser automation run locally; there is no hosted project backend.
- Student data may still be processed by the user's chosen MCP client/AI provider and by ClassDojo after confirmation.
- Roster writes require a 15-minute, single-use preview ID and `confirm: true`, then perform read-back verification.
- Classroom-skill writes use the same preview and confirmation gate, detect post-preview changes, and verify names, categories, points, and icons.
- `traditional_chinese_classroom_v1` is a public neutral preset with nine positive and six needs-work rules; the guided prompt asks the user whether to modify it before previewing.
- `seat_number_dot_name` preserves names such as `1.Student A` through individual entry. `name_only` uses bulk paste.
- Awarding points, attendance, messages, family invitations, and other sensitive ClassDojo writes are not available.

Do not describe this project as an official ClassDojo API, official MCP server, hosted service, or credential-free access mechanism.
